note: Taxonomy Entity Index maintains a denormalized taxonomy_entity_index table (entity_type, bundle, entity_id, revision_id, field_name, delta, tid) mapping content entities to referenced taxonomy terms, for the entity types selected in taxonomy_entity_index.settings:types (plus booleans index_revisions and index_per_field). Settings form route taxonomy_entity_index.admin at /admin/config/system/taxonomy-entity-index; reindex form taxonomy_entity_index.admin_reindex. Drush command taxonomy_entity_index:rebuild (aliases tei:rebuild, tei-rebuild). Ships Views argument/field/filter plugins with hierarchy depth. Medium/hard cases read and write the real taxonomy_entity_index.settings config object.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal taxonomy_entity_index module, how do I control which entity types get indexed? Name the config object and key.
evals.expected_output: The taxonomy_entity_index.settings config object holds a 'types' list of entity type IDs to index (set on the settings form at /admin/config/system/taxonomy-entity-index), plus booleans index_revisions and index_per_field.

evals.prompt: Which Drush command rebuilds the taxonomy_entity_index table, and how do I rebuild only certain entity types?
evals.expected_output: drush taxonomy_entity_index:rebuild (aliases tei:rebuild / tei-rebuild). With no argument it rebuilds all configured types; pass a comma list to limit, e.g. drush tei:rebuild node,media.

evals.prompt: What database table does the taxonomy_entity_index module maintain, and what does each row represent (name some columns)?
evals.expected_output: It maintains the taxonomy_entity_index table; each row maps an entity revision/field/delta to a term: columns entity_type, bundle, entity_id, revision_id, field_name, delta, tid.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the taxonomy_entity_index module has been configured. Inspect the live configuration and report which entity type(s) it is currently set to index.
evals.expected_output: It is configured to index the 'node' entity type (taxonomy_entity_index.settings:types = [node]); index_revisions is also on.

evals.prompt: Inspect this site's taxonomy_entity_index configuration and state whether it is set to maintain separate indexes for each field (per-field indexing). Which config flag tells you?
evals.expected_output: Yes — taxonomy_entity_index.settings:index_per_field is TRUE, so a separate row is kept per field.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the taxonomy_entity_index module so that the 'node' entity type is indexed. Apply the change to the live site configuration.
evals.expected_output: taxonomy_entity_index.settings:types contains 'node' (e.g. set types to ['node'] and save, or tick node on the settings form).

evals.prompt: Configure the taxonomy_entity_index module on this site to index the node entity type AND to also maintain indexes for historical revisions. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: taxonomy_entity_index.settings:types contains 'node' and index_revisions is TRUE.
